email.subject: Quick fix for Saltwater Co's site
email.body:
Hi Sam,

I took a look at Saltwater Co Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no way to book online, so anyone checking after hours has to remember to call back and often doesn't, and the site isn't mobile-friendly, which is how most people search for a salon on their phone before calling.

I fix local business sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
